A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

our observations are consistent with the presence of a large Comptonization parameter in the center of Coma, but the limits are weak and the observations are not sensitive to a large range of Comptonization parameter profiles.

our observations are consistent with a Coma cluster model in which the SZ effect is negligible in the central region and is dominated by the Comptonization of the microwave background by the cluster's outskirts, as predicted by models of the cluster's structure.

the Coma cluster is consistent with the standard model, but the observations cannot rule out the possibility that the Coma electrons are significantly hotter or more extended than predicted by X-ray observations.
